description: Appraise up to 10 domain names and rank them by estimated fair value, flagging adjacent pairs whose intervals overlap so their order is not separable. Use run_bracket instead for one champion from a head-to-head tournament of up to 8 names, tiers not values. Deterministic. More than 10 names, or a request cut off by the engine budget, returns a handoffUrl that runs the same engine free in the browser. Without a key, only catalog and recently appraised names get a figure; other names return a report link, nearest published names and a next step instead. A fresh engine run needs an API key sent as the HTTP header Authorization: Bearer ad_live_... on the MCP connection, and spends one API credit per name the engine runs; catalog and cached names cost nothing.

domains.description: Domain names to rank, such as example.com. Up to 10 are appraised here; 11 to 16 return handoffUrl only.

name: compare_domains

citeAs.description: A structured citation. Quote `text` or build your own from the fields. Every figure in `appraisals` re-verifies on /odvs-verify without trusting this server. Tools whose answer is not an appraisal (a bracket, which withholds estimates by contract, and the recorded-sales tools, whose rows are not hashed) return an empty `appraisals`.

items.description: One appraisal holding exactly the fields its ODVS hashes commit to. Paste it into https://audit.domains/odvs-verify/ to recompute all three hashes client-side. appraisalHash is the appraisal's identity; resultDigest checks the output only.

confidence.description: Internal 0-100 model score, NOT a probability.

methodologyVersion.description: The methodology revision hashed into this record (as rev-<value>, or rev-n/a when null). It, not citeAs.revision, produced the figure.

edition.description: ODVS edition id; null until editions are published.

revision.description: The methodology revision live on the server at retrieval. A record's own methodologyVersion is what produced its figure and can differ.

handoffUrl.description: Present when this request could not run every name here (over the tool cap, or cut off by the per-request engine budget): a link to the free page that runs the same deterministic computation for all of them in the reader's browser. Give it to the user rather than retrying.

inseparablePairs.description: Adjacent pairs whose published intervals overlap; the ordering between them is not separable by this method.

next.description: The one step that moves this name forward: {tool, arguments} to call next on this server, or {url} to open; why says what it gets. Null when nothing here does (for a free name, registering it at a registrar).

notAppraised.description: Names that did not run here (over the tool cap, or cut off by the request budget). They are absent from the ranking, not ranked last - see handoffUrl.

items.description: The locked public appraisal projection. confidence is an internal 0-100 model score, not a probability that the figure is correct; always present valueRange alongside valueUSD.

basis.description: Why this sale was matched, naming the channel the matcher scored on (shared keyword, word family, same industry, structural cohort, spelling, length/zone). null means the basis was not recorded - treat the match as unexplained rather than assuming a reason.

priceRange.description: The 1-2-5 band holding the recorded price (low inclusive, high exclusive). Exact recorded prices are not published on this free surface.

confidence.description: Internal 0-100 model score, NOT a probability.

title: Compare and rank domain names
